# Component tree

`ChartWorkspace` is the drop-in: one component, and everything below is what it assembles.
It composes **18 components**, read out of the JSX in
`src/react/workspace/ChartWorkspace.tsx` and resolved tag by tag to where each is declared.

Host elements appear as `<tag>` and carry no origin. A component declared in the root file is
expanded in place rather than named and left closed, so the tree is one connected shape from the
drop-in down. A tag that resolves to no declaration is a generator error, not a blank line.

```text
ChartWorkspace
`-- WorkspaceChromeProvider  -- react/chrome/ChromeContext
    `-- WorkspaceSetupProvider  -- react/workspace/setupContext
        `-- CandlePatternsProvider  -- react/workspace/PatternChipsSection
            `-- DrawingRailProvider  -- react/workspace/DrawingRail
                `-- WorkspaceBody
                    `-- <fieldset>
                        |-- TabsRegion  -- react/workspace/TabsRegion
                        `-- <div>
                            |-- <div>
                            |   |-- SymbolTrigger  -- react/workspace/SymbolTrigger
                            |   |-- IntervalRegion  -- react/workspace/IntervalRegion
                            |   |-- GridControls  -- react/workspace/GridControls
                            |   |-- PrimaryActions  -- react/workspace/PrimaryActions
                            |   |-- SeriesMenuRegion  -- react/workspace/SeriesMenuRegion
                            |   `-- StylePickerRegion  -- react/workspace/StylePickerRegion
                            |-- Notice  -- chrome slot, from `components`
                            |-- CanvasRow  -- react/workspace/CanvasRow
                            |   |-- DrawingRail  -- react/workspace/DrawingRail
                            |   |-- CanvasSurface  -- react/workspace/CanvasSurface
                            |   `-- CompactGrid  -- react/workspace/CompactGrid
                            `-- StatusFooter  -- react/workspace/StatusFooter
```

For what each region does, see the page named after its module in this directory. For why the
composition is cut this way, see
[`../explanation/react-workspace.md`](../explanation/react-workspace.md).
